name: io.github.hawkmill/app-pain-api
title: App Pain API
description: What users hate about ANY iOS/Android app: clustered complaints, evidence, trends. No key needed.

tools.name: search_apps
tools.description: Search the iOS App Store and Google Play (both merged by default) to find apps and their ids; WordPress plugins / Chrome extensions / Steam games via store:"wordpress"|"chrome"|"steam". Use this FIRST when you only know an app name or a category. Results carry name/developer/rating/rating count — the count is your volume signal when picking apps to compare.

store.description: limit to one store (default: iOS + Android merged; the others need to be passed explicitly)

tools.name: mine_app_pain_points
tools.description: THE core tool: fetch recent reviews of any iOS/Android app, keep the negative ones, and cluster them into ranked pain points (title, sharePercent, severity 1-5, verbatim evidence quotes). Ideal for competitive research and product discovery. Cached 7 days (instant on repeat); a COLD server-side analysis takes 30-120s. If the result has "mode":"agent", it contains prepared negative reviews and "instructions" — do the clustering yourself and present it to the user. Not available for Steam (mine the game's mobile counterpart instead).

appId.description: App Store / Google Play / Steam / WordPress.org / Chrome Web Store URL, iOS / Mac App Store numeric id (e.g. 324684580), Android package (e.g. com.spotify.music), Steam appid (e.g. 730), WordPress plugin slug (e.g. woocommerce) or Chrome extension id — get ids from search_apps

store.description: optional — inferred from appId (App Store URL or 5-12 digit id → ios, Play URL / package → android, Steam URL or 1-4 digit appid → steam); iOS and Mac App Store share the same URL shape, so pass "macos" explicitly for Mac apps. steam: details/search only for now — mining/reviews return steam_reviews_unavailable

reviews.description: reviews to analyze, default 300 (other values round up to these tiers; Apple rate limiting can occasionally cap depth below the target)

maxRating.description: ratings <= this count as negative, default 3

analyze.description: who clusters on a cold run: "server" = our model; "agent" = you get the prepared negative reviews + instructions and cluster them with your own model; "auto" (default) = server, switching to agent when the server-side allowance is used up

tools.name: get_pain_trend
tools.description: How an app's pain points changed over time: compares two archived analyses and labels each theme new / resolved / rising / falling / stable with share deltas (percentage points). Instant (archive read, no LLM). Default: latest vs ~30 days earlier. Returns a note when the app has fewer than two snapshots yet.

appId.description: App Store / Google Play / Steam / WordPress.org / Chrome Web Store URL, iOS / Mac App Store numeric id (e.g. 324684580), Android package (e.g. com.spotify.music), Steam appid (e.g. 730), WordPress plugin slug (e.g. woocommerce) or Chrome extension id — get ids from search_apps

tools.name: get_app_details
tools.description: App metadata: name, developer, category, price, average rating, rating count and 1-5★ histogram (when available).

tools.name: get_version_history
tools.description: Per-version review stats (review count, average rating, first/last seen) — spot a rating crash right after a bad release. Android: aggregated from recent reviews. iOS: current version + release notes. Steam: not available (Steam exposes no per-version data — returns an empty list).

tools.name: watch_competitors
tools.description: Continuous competitor monitoring (paid plans: Starter 2 apps weekly, Pro 15 apps daily). Manage the watchlist and the alert destination; digests of NEW 1-2★ reviews and NEW/RISING pain points are pushed to a Slack / Discord / any https webhook. action: list | add | remove | set_webhook | test.

appId.description: for add/remove: store URL, iOS/Mac id, Android package or Steam appid

store.description: optional — inferred from appId (App Store URL or 5-12 digit id → ios, Play URL / package → android, Steam URL or 1-4 digit appid → steam); iOS and Mac App Store share the same URL shape, so pass "macos" explicitly for Mac apps. steam: details/search only for now — mining/reviews return steam_reviews_unavailable

webhookUrl.description: for set_webhook (or add): https URL, e.g. a Slack incoming webhook or Discord channel webhook

tools.name: get_app_reviews
tools.description: Fetch raw app reviews (unified schema across stores: rating/title/body/version/date/devReply/thumbsUp), 50 per page. Use for drill-down after mine_app_pain_points.

sort.description: default recent (Android: both supported; iOS/macOS use the store default order)
